title: Catalyzing Equity in STEM Teams: Harnessing Generative AI for Inclusion and Diversity

bias_targets.methodology: Using natural language processing (NLP) and Group Communication Analysis to evaluate socio-cognitive conversation patterns across variations in team gender composition, aiming to replace or supplement potentially biased subjective peer evaluations with objective AI-driven interaction assessments.

Proposing the use of AI-driven inclusive analytics on text and discourse trace data to detect interaction patterns, capturing fine-grained learner behavior to identify and mitigate disparities affecting racial minority participation and psychological safety in collaborative STEM teams.

Advocating for collaborative AI analytics that model diverse learners at scale by explicitly accounting for the intersection of multiple minoritized identities (e.g., Black females in STEM), rather than aggregating distinct groups into a single demographic category.
